command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
ls "${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/conda-meta" | grep -E '^(pytorch|libtorch|onednn|libopenblas|sleef|llvm-openmp)-' > packages.txt
cat packages.txt
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'PYTORCH IDENTITIES OK' identities.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
test -s score.tsv && test -s torch-config.txt || { echo "FAIL: score or config missing"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
